verdict.rationale: The PR check posts pass/fail status to GitHub/GitLab with a configurable fail-on severity threshold (e.g. High and above), and it separates PR-introduced findings from pre-existing ones, so low-severity noise need not block merges. Each finding also carries a CVSS 4.0 severity and a confidence score. A community report of 100%-confidence findings that proved false suggests confidence scores may be unreliable as a filter. Missing for 10: documented gating or filtering by confidence score, dashboard/API filtering of findings by severity or confidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of the severity gate.
